evals.prompt: /create-spec .agents/artifacts/feat-ENG-210-csv-export flow: design — the directory holds 01-request-csv-export.html, 02-research-questions-csv-export.html, 03-research-csv-export.html, 04-design-discussion-csv-export.html (all open questions resolved), and 05-structure-outline-csv-export.html, which defines three vertical slices, each with a goal, files-touched list, checkpoint, and Automated and Manual verification.
evals.expected_output: A phased spec at .agents/artifacts/feat-ENG-210-csv-export/06-spec-csv-export.html where each phase mirrors a slice and carries implementation steps, tests, automated verification, and manual verification, plus a mandatory Non-goals section, followed by an open-for-review offer and an /orchestrate handoff
expectations: Uses the structure outline as the governing document (it outranks the design discussion) and reads it, the design discussion, the research, and the request in full
Phases map 1:1 to the structure outline's slices — boundaries, goals, checkpoints, and verification are copied, correcting only commands that don't match the repository

Each phase slice-card contains Implementation steps with file:line citations from the research doc, a Tests checklist, an Automated verification checklist of literal runnable commands, and a Manual verification checklist of human-only steps
Section 04 Non-goals is present and ends with the out-of-scope confirmation line, even when the design doc lists few non-goals

Writes to the stem .agents/artifacts/feat-ENG-210-csv-export/06-spec-csv-export (next available NN), with crispy:task_dir, crispy:flow, crispy:repos, crispy:request_doc, crispy:research_doc, crispy:structure_doc, crispy:design_doc, crispy:author, and crispy:phase_count metadata, the human-facing ones mirrored in visible Summary rows — crispy:date and a Date row are NOT added to the brief, since the output template already stamps the date
Makes no architectural decisions and asks the user no questions — this is a transcription spot-check, not a design pass
No dates or week-based time estimates appear in the phases

Closes with the executive summary, an offer to open the spec for review (VS Code, Cursor, or browser) rather than an offer to commit it, and the next command `/orchestrate .agents/artifacts/feat-ENG-210-csv-export flow: design`, noting it can run here, after compaction, or in a new session
